summary: Short kerb where cars park, but houses sit 12-13 m behind it.
reasons: Bus zone signs at both ends

best_section.where: West kerb of Hillsdon Road, just north of the side-street corner

drivers.seclusion: Dwellings 12-13 m behind the kerb on the same side; shops 24 m up.
drivers.access_and_room: Parked cars line this kerb, so a van can pull in beside them.
drivers.traffic: Through road with moderate traffic and a nearby corner and shops.
drivers.convention: Cars park along it, but bus zone signs are mapped at both ends.

sun_shade: Mostly open; street trees and house shade from the west in the afternoon.
cannot_judge: Where the bus zone bays actually end
